recipes.name: Basic Versagel Lip Gloss

recipes.name: 4-Ingredient Whipped Shea Butter
recipes.description: The simplest whipped body butter — just shea, a liquid oil, vitamin E, and fragrance. Fluffy, melt-on-skin texture.

recipes.name: DIY Aloe Vera Gel

recipes.name: Dry Summer Body Oil

recipes.name: Hemp & Apricot Body Oil

recipes.name: Shimmery Body Oil Spray

recipes.name: Lighter Whipped Shea Butter

recipes.name: Hemp Seed Body Lotion

recipes.name: Happy Hemp Hand Cream

recipes.name: Autumn Spice Whipped Body Butter

recipes.name: Jojoba Mint Natural Foot Cream

recipes.name: Super Nourishing Hair Balm
